about_the_game:
PLAY THE DEMO AND EXPERIENCE THE WRATH OF WOMAN!

25 DRAMA-FILLED LEVELS AWAITS YOU!

BEAT THE CLOCK, TAME HER WRATH, SAVE THE DAY.

When a woman gets angry, the world trembles—windows shatter, volcanoes erupt, and people cower in fear! It’s your job to save the world by taming her tantrums. In this fast-paced puzzle game, you race against the clock to arrange comic-style illustrations using subtle hints, piecing together the chain of events that sparked each meltdown.

A puzzle game like no other - blending sharp humor with clever mechanics. With comic-book flair, pin-up sass, and beautifully animated sequences, the game drops you into a gallery of scenarios that are sometimes hilariously absurd, sometimes uncomfortably relatable.

It’s part puzzle-solving, part comedy of errors - a mix that keeps you guessing, laughing, and sometimes cringing at just how familiar it all feels. A perfect icebreaker game - entertaining not just for players, but also for anyone watching.

FEATURES:

  • Unique fast-paced puzzle gameplay: under a ticking clock, decode the hints, line up the illustrations, and watch the tantrum take shape

  • 150+ hilarious tantrum scenarios from absurd misunderstandings to relatable everyday conflicts - spanning date nights, family matters, parties, gaming nights and plenty more

  • Absurd yet painfully relatable situations that will make you either howl from secondhand embarrassment or laugh at their sheer stupidity.

  • Three distinct playable characters, each with their own quirks, personality, and tantrum triggers.

  • Balanced humor: lightheartedly pokes fun at stereotypes for both men and women.

  • Stylish visuals blending comic book flair with retro pin-up aesthetics.

  • Beautifully animated comic book sequences that bring every meltdown to life.

  • Hidden ending: sometimes even failure has a silver lining - your choices and “mistakes” can unlock unexpected outcomes.

content_descriptors.notes: female characters have slightly revealing clothes

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina or later (64-bit Intel)
  • Processor: Intel dual‑core (2.0 GHz) or Apple Silicon (via Rosetta 2; see notes)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD 4000+ / Intel Iris) or discrete GPU with Metal support
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: CoreAudio‑compatible audio device (built-in speakers/headphones or USB sound card); stereo output required
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or newer (native Apple Silicon + Intel supported)
  • Processor: Quad‑core Intel or Apple Silicon (M1/M2)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with Metal support (Apple Silicon GPU, Intel Iris Plus or better)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: CoreAudio‑compatible audio device with proper drivers; stereo or multichannel headphone/speaker setup recommended.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Processor: Dual‑core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU (Intel HD 4000 / Intel UHD / low-end dedicated GPU)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound / WASAPI compatible audio device (integrated audio or basic 2‑channel sound card); stereo output or headphones required
  • VR Support: no VR Device support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad‑core 2.5 GHz (Intel Core i5 or Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11/12 compatible GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or Intel Iris Xe)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Dedicated or integrated audio device with proper drivers (WASAPI/DirectSound / OpenAL-compatible); stereo or multichannel output supported. Headphones or speakers recommended for best experience.
  • VR Support: no VR Device support

short_description: Her wrath shakes the earth - windows shatter, lava flows, everyone panics! Save the day by solving lightning-fast puzzles. Jump into the comic world, arrange illustrations and reveal the chain of events behind her explosive tantrums.
